title: Needle in the Hay

sections.name: Verse
sections.bars: F/C | Am | F/C | C | E | Am | F/C | Am | F/C | E | Am

why: **F/C** — a slash chord that keeps C in the bass under F — and holding a drone-like feel at speed.
hard_change: **F/C → E at tempo** (verse bars 9–10). The index lifts off the barre; the ring and little fingers drop one string.
theory: Aeolian i–VI in A minor with V (E major, the harmonic-minor dominant).
steps: Changes alone, slowly: F/C → Am → F/C → E.
With the rhythm at 70% (about 80 bpm), tight eighths.
caveat: The harmony agrees across sources but the best-fetched tab is poorly rated, and the picked intro figure is unverified.
